faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about subscriptions, upgrades, points, auto-renewal, and invoices.
faq.q1: How do I start and cancel a subscription?
faq.a1: Select a subscription plan, confirm the price and duration, complete payment, and immediately receive the corresponding access when the subscription activates. The Personal Plan supports subscription and use only by the main account. The platform defaults to auto-renew annually or monthly. To cancel, unsubscribe on the top-right page to stop auto-renewal.
faq.q2: What happens after the subscription expires?
faq.a2: Services usually last until the current cycle ends. After expiration, the service stops automatically. You can renew to continue the service.
faq.a3: Subscribed plans do not support refunds. You can cancel auto-renewal, and cancellation takes effect after the current service expires.
faq.a4: Upgrade refers to moving from a lower-level subscription to a higher-level one, such as Basic to Advanced. Each upgrade is treated as repurchasing the corresponding resource service, and the system automatically charges the price difference between old and new configurations.
faq.q5: What are the billing rules for upgrading?
faq.a5: Monthly plans can upgrade to monthly payment plans valid for 1 month, and annual plans can upgrade to annual payment plans valid for 1 year. Upgrading only supports monthly-to-monthly and annual-to-annual upgrades. After upgrading, points from the original package are cleared, and the current month's points for the new package are allocated immediately.
faq.q6: If I have already renewed, can I still upgrade?
faq.a6: Yes, upgrades are supported at any time. For upgrade cycle calculation, if the remaining period is less than 1 month, it counts as 1 month; for example, 1.5 months remaining counts as 2 months.
faq.q7: Will the original data be retained after the upgrade?
faq.a7: Yes. All historical data is fully retained, generated content remains unaffected, and only permissions and functional scope expand.
faq.q8: What should I do if the upgrade fails?
faq.a8: Check whether the payment method is valid, confirm the account balance is sufficient, and contact technical support for assistance if needed.
faq.q9: Can the same account have multiple subscription plans simultaneously?
faq.a9: Only one active subscription plan is allowed per account at the same time, but the points add-on package can be purchased multiple times.
faq.q10: What are the rules for point validity?
faq.a10: Points in the subscription plan are distributed monthly; the current month's points are automatically cleared and updated each month. Points in the increment package are valid for 2 years and will be used upon plan activation.
faq.q11: What are the rules for automatic renewal?
faq.a11: Accounts with auto-renewal enabled will start attempting to deduct fees to renew the package at 0:00, 7 days before the current plan expires.
faq.a12: If you need an invoice, visit the official website for self-service invoice issuance.
